title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Blood Orange Pineapple 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Embark on a fabulous flavour adventure with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fill's Blood Orange Pineapple, an e-liquid that's brimming with exotic zest and tropical goodness. Right from the start, the blood orange makes its presence felt with its unique blend of tangy and sweet notes. It's like a citrus whirlwind, delighting your senses with its complex taste that goes beyond the typical orange. Just when you think you've unravelled the complexity of the blood orange, the pineapple comes into play. It's not just a backup singer; it’s a standout performer that adds its own tropical flair. Sweet, succulent, and irresistibly juicy, the pineapple intertwines with the blood orange to create a rich and layered flavour experience. You're not just vaping an e-liquid; you're savoring a tropical cocktail. Blood Orange Pineapple offers a refreshing experience that will make you feel like you've been transported to a sunny beach, even on the greyest of days. It's a flavour that constantly keeps you engaged, with every puff revealing new, subtle notes that make this e-liquid so special. Discover unparalleled vaping bliss with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fills. Boasting ten mouth-watering, double-concentrated flavours, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to tantalise your taste buds while keeping nicotine cravings at bay. Unique in their 50/50 VG/PG blend, Pod Fills are versatile, ideal for Starter Kits , MTL Pod Kits , and devices with coils of 0.8ohm or higher. Enjoy the convenience of a 100ml shortfill bottle, complete with 20ml of extra space for your preferred nicotine shot. For instance, add 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots to create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.
